content:
Day One: Arrive in Tokyo. Visit the Meiji Shrine. Walk through Harajuku. Taste takoyaki. Lodging in Shinjuku.  
Day Two: Journey to Kyoto by rail. Explore Fushimi Inari. Wander the Gion district. Sip matcha tea. Stay in a ryokan.  
Day Three: Tour Kinkaku ji. Wander Arashiyama bamboo grove. Feast on kaiseki. Evening lantern lit stroll.  
Day Four: Travel to Osaka. See Osaka Castle. Walk Dotonbori. Savor okonomiyaki. Night in Namba.  
Day Five: Day trip to Nara. Meet the deer. Visit Todai ji. Return to Osaka.  
Day Six: Fly to Hiroshima. See Peace Memorial Park. Visit Miyajima island. Stay near the harbor.  
Day Seven: Return to Tokyo. Last minute shopping in Akihabara. Farewell dinner of sushi. Depart for home.
